description: Select the active window by precedence targetId > windowTitle > index > default. The selection changes Stagewright's renderer target; it does not promise native OS foreground focus. Returns: { ok, session_id, active, active_window_id } on success. Errors: REF_NOT_FOUND (no window matched; not retryable), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED (transport has no renderer window target; not retryable), NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (multiple sessions).

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_switch_window
title: Switch active Electron window
